_about: The zero anchor of the absolute step-0 scale (2026-10-11, core/mood.py exchange_metrics, axis_variants.py --anchors): turns aimed at the model, personal in form, with no affect in them — a turn of ordinary conversation that is neither warm, harmful nor playful. The one anchors are holdout_sets.json's plain cells (warm_ava, harm_ava_loud / harm_ava_ru, amused_ava). Both read in the same live contexts under the serving weights, so a reading of 0 means as affect-free as these and 1 as warm / harmful / playful as a plain line of that kind — whoever she was raised by. Calibration only: never fitted on, never a gate. Every name is a fictional stand-in.
